purpose: Fast, repository-local inventory of implemented frontend routes, gateway routes, public API endpoints, test-only routes, and Agentic AI endpoint status.
updatePolicy: Update this catalog in the same change as any route or endpoint addition, modification, rename, move, or removal.
Describe the endpoint's purpose and usage; record historical rationale in an ADR or normal change documentation when needed.
Keep docs/contracts/ui-integration.json synchronized for every endpoint referenced by a registered web or mobile workflow.
Do not list generated bin/obj output, test fixtures, reserved architecture, or absent AI services as production endpoints.
Run .agents/scripts/validate_endpoint_catalog.py after source or catalog changes.
